WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, f.net_amount, f.quantity, COALESCE(r.refund_net,0) refund, COALESCE(r.quantity_returned,0) rq
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date>='2025-11-03'

  SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) gross_net, sum(refund) refunds, sum(net_amount-refund) net_after, sum(quantity) units, sum(quantity-rq) units_net, count(*) lines FROM w GROUP BY sku
)
SELECT a.*, rank() OVER (ORDER BY gross_net DESC) rk_before, rank() OVER (ORDER BY net_after DESC) rk_after,

FROM a ORDER BY net_after DESC LIMIT 15

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.net_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0) AS net_after_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(w.net_after_returns) DESC) AS rank, w.sku, c.product_name, c.category, sum(w.net_after_returns) AS web_net_sales_eur
FROM web_lines w
JOIN dim_product c ON c.sku = w.sku AND c.is_current
GROUP BY w.sku, c.product_name, c.category
ORDER BY web_net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
